== Summary ==
Original Japanese [[They're On Dantooine (Japanese)|They're On Dantooine]] from [[A New Hope (Japanese)]]. Card-face crop from [https://www.psacard.com/psasetregistry/tcg/company-sets/1997-decipher-star-wars-ccg-new-hope-limited-japanese/imagegallery/587873 Robert John's Japanese Hoth PSA showcase], [https://d1htnxwo4o0jhw.cloudfront.net/cert/156625024/4x2Xun4VBU-tX3wZutx8xg.jpg source photograph], PSA certificate 89673880.

Crop rectangle <code>(145, 620, 1290, 2220)</code> after applying the source orientation. Source SHA-256 <code>8dfa1b4d56980d1249c647d96ce0fec5a4d05c109062df2a59f77735da89d88d</code>. Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc., 1997.
